profile_text.body:
Jasper is a for-profit startup founded in 2021 and headquartered in Austin, TX, that builds AI tools aimed at marketing teams. The company describes its product experience as drawing on advanced language models, context-aware intelligence, and intuitive agents designed to let marketers customize AI for their own workflows.

Jasper's tracked products cover writing and image generation. The writing side includes Jasper, a marketing copy tool, and Jasper Campaigns, which the company positions as an end-to-end solution for cross-channel content with brand voice controls and a governance dashboard. On the image side, Jasper Art handles marketing image generation and brand asset creation for commercial use, and the company's Image Pipelines feature is described as delivering product imagery at ten times the speed and up to 50 percent lower cost than conventional methods. The site also references the ability to measure brand performance across AI answer engines and ship brand-governed content at scale.

No litigation, MCP server registrations, SEC filings, or patent records appear in the available data for Jasper.
